title: Pre-registered falsification rules for the thesis engine
authority: Registered before the sealed ledger accrues evidence. Editing a rule after registration voids it; add a new versioned rule instead. Rules display and demand action — nothing retires silently.

rules.label: Factor spine decay
rules.rule: Rolling 5-year Newey–West t-statistic of the HML_RD premium < 1.0 for four consecutive quarters
rules.consequence: The factor spine claim drops to zero: μ_claim := 0, sizing bound stays 0, and F0 keeps gating but every BUY carries a 'spine decayed' banner pending re-validation. BUY→HOLD for names whose only support was the spine.
rules.inputs: Quarterly re-run of the paper factor regression on extending data
rules.evaluable_when: The rolling factor series is re-computed quarterly (not yet wired into the product)

rules.label: Sealed ledger failure
rules.rule: With n ≥ 36 sealed monthly snapshots, the equal-weight BUY book's excess return over SPY has t < 0
rules.consequence: The engine version is retired publicly: the What-to-Buy view states the ledger falsified close_call_v3 and no successor ships without a written post-mortem.
rules.inputs: buy_set_snapshots kind='sealed' forward returns vs benchmark

rules.label: Fair-band calibration break
rules.rule: Realized gap-closure by MoS bucket deviates from the convergence assumption by more than 2× in either direction
rules.consequence: The band model (valuation triangulation) is revised and re-sealed; implied-return copy is suspended until the revision ships.
rules.inputs: Sealed MoS buckets vs realized 12m forward gap closure
rules.evaluable_when: ≥ 12 sealed months of forward outcomes per bucket

display_requirement: Every rule with its live status (armed_passing / armed_not_yet_evaluable / breached) must be visible on the BUY performance book surface. A breached rule is a product event, not a log line.
